## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it addresses or feature it implements.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] UI / UX enhancement (improving macOS visual fidelity)
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist:
